title: Bee Removal in Dobbs Ferry, NY
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee nest treatment and removal in Dobbs Ferry, Westchester. Licensed technicians. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: Stinging insects in Dobbs Ferry — wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, and ground bees — build nests in wall voids, soffits, eaves, chimneys, and structural wood throughout this historic Westchester village. An active nest inside your home or business is a structural problem that requires identification, treatment, and entry-point sealing. The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional nest treatment and removal for residential and commercial properties in Dobbs Ferry.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has served Dobbs Ferry and the greater Westchester area for years with proven expertise in safe bee removal. Our licensed technicians use eco-friendly methods to relocate bee colonies while ensuring your family's safety, and we offer competitive pricing from $350 to $550 with same-day emergency service available.
localContext: From the historic homes near the Old Croton Aqueduct Trail to waterfront properties along the Hudson River and the classic residences in downtown Dobbs Ferry, wasp and hornet colonies establish paper nests in chimneys, eaves, and wall voids. The village's mature trees and beautiful landscaping around areas like Waterfront Park and Gould Park create ideal nesting sites for yellow jackets, paper wasps, and bald-faced hornets seeking cavities and sheltered overhangs.

faqs.question: How quickly can you treat a wasp or hornet nest in my Dobbs Ferry property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and next-day service for wasp and hornet nest removal in Dobbs Ferry. Most jobs are completed within 2–4 hours, though wall-void nests or hard-to-reach locations may require additional time. faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Dobbs Ferry?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Will wasps or hornets return after nest removal?
faqs.answer: Our service includes nest treatment, removal of accessible nest material, and sealing of every entry point to prevent recolonization. Every service includes a service agreement — terms depend on the service and are confirmed on the call.
